title: Woman Lets Stranger Take Her Child to School, What Could Go Wrong?
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On September 15th, 2023. An officer conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle that committed a traffic violation and for a child in the backseat not wearing a seatbelt. It turned out that the woman let this man she met on a social media site, spend the night and let him take her kid and her friends kid to work, he got pulled over and started acting strange and couldn't provide solid id apart from the woman's car registration. The man then got agitated and scared and proceeded to drive off with a child in the car. This is the body-cam  footage of the events that followed.
